implemented_wire_behaviors: The opt-in market worker supports instrument.search and market.getBars for compatible legacy callers. Negotiated 1.1 adds market.readHistoryPage and finite market.subscribe replay. The generic market worker launched without the sample advertises no market operations.
The dedicated local import worker accepts bounded NDJSON frames containing Rust-read CSV bytes and the selected mapping. The shared local preview operation runs through the application registry.

Trusted local users can publish a complete native CSV as an immutable profile-local revision, read its bars and source row locators, and remove its display permission through the application registry. Publication uses the profile-bound Rust SQLite writer.
clarifications: Workspace revisions are non-negative safe integers; dataset revisions are opaque provider-owned strings.
Operation outputs are objects. instrument.search wraps its array in instruments.
Worker hello is unsolicited; the host validates the negotiated version, required capabilities and expected role before sending work.
Cancel references request_id; heartbeat has only common envelope fields.
Schema definitions are canonical. Small per-operation schemas and all language types are generated from them.
Metadata, params, provenance and error details are explicit data bags; they never confer authority.
Schema validation is structural. Cross-field market invariants, AST budgets, role authorization and response correlation require application validation.
Specifying a payload does not expose or implement that operation. Unsupported operations fail closed.
Decision-note commands and operation-specific replies use the private local workspace transport. The core checks current profile access and issues short-lived confirmations for writes.
first_product_scenario: Start from a blank workbench and compose an original view from authorized local evidence with the embedded AI. Adjust one detail, refresh, undo and reopen it. The default chart also supports the existing analysis, indicator preview and immutable acceptance journey.
development_data: Explicit synthetic demo and development samples. The native CSV picker grants session-only directory access, while frozen revisions remain available under profile rights. Saved local sources and Parquet are current requirements awaiting implementation.
service_capabilities: The current contract requires M1-030 to deliver Settings > Data sources > My data sources on a fresh install. Users can select a folder containing market files they downloaded or configure their own API endpoint and credential fields. They can test, save, refresh and disconnect their sources without a ScopeHub account or plan. Verify the API setup and lifecycle with a controlled connector. Only the selected connector uses locally stored provider credentials. Optional ScopeHub data services are labeled and selected separately. Live external market-data provider delivery and qualification remain later (M1-009). Internal model adapters, external AI clients and eligible ScopeHub services are independently selected and authorized. Production services and client access are unconfigured.

operation_authorization.replay: Scope the stable idempotency key to the authenticated principal, paired client identity where used, workspace and operation. Authenticate the caller and validate the request shape, then look up the scoped key before applying the current revision, target and confirmation checks for new work. Reject a reused key with different semantic input. A matching committed retry, including after reconnection within the same scope, recovers the original receipt subject to current disclosure grants and applicable source entitlements. Project any required result fields under those same permissions. If the registered reply cannot be formed within those permissions, return only a permitted status. Never return a raw historical result. Recover the receipt without re-execution or renewed confirmation, even if revisions advanced, the target changed or the original confirmation expired.
operation_authorization.tauri: An allowlist of capabilities for the main window; do not expose general shell, arbitrary filesystem, or arbitrary SQL interfaces to the UI

durable_operations.commit: For new work, revalidate the current grant, workspace, target and expected_workspace_revision. Independently revalidate expected_selection_revision for writes bound to shared selection. Atomically consume required approval, apply the mutation, advance the durable workspace revision and persist the immutable operation receipt and scoped idempotency record in the single-writer transaction. Failure before commit has no visible effect. Serial or concurrent duplicates have one commit.
durable_operations.receipt: Return the stable operation ID, committed workspace revision, affected target identity and undo eligibility. Recover a lost committed response under /authorization/replay. A stale new request or an unauthorized request returns only the permitted status.
durable_operations.undo: Undo targets an eligible operation ID. Check current grant, requested workspace revision, affected object and recorded after-state. Reject conflicting intervening edits without clobbering them. Otherwise record a new inverse operation with its own receipt; repeated retries do not undo twice.
